_note: Claims the library may rely on, with source and verification status. 'verified' = confirmed against a primary source or Beema's own live page. Anything else forces NEEDS_HUMAN_REVIEW in the compliance gate when a script uses it.

pde5_mechanism.text: PDE5 inhibitors block the enzyme that breaks down cGMP, so blood vessels can relax and widen when there is sexual stimulation.
pde5_mechanism.source: FDA prescribing information for sildenafil and tadalafil (DailyMed); in-repo explainer SCRIPT.md

needs_stimulation.text: These medicines do not cause arousal by themselves; sexual stimulation is still needed.

nitrate_contraindication.text: Sildenafil and tadalafil must not be taken with nitrates or riociguat.

priapism.text: An erection lasting more than 4 hours needs emergency care.

vision_hearing.text: Sudden vision or hearing loss is a reason to stop and get medical help.
vision_hearing.source: FDA labeling warnings (NAION, sudden hearing loss). Note: warnings, not contraindications.

generic_fda_approved.text: Beema Health's sildenafil and tadalafil are FDA-approved generic medications dispensed by a licensed pharmacy.

mints_503b.text: ED Mints are compounded at an FDA-registered 503B outsourcing facility and are not FDA-approved.

mints_timing.text: Most patients take one about 30 minutes before sexual activity; provider confirms timing and dosing.

ed_common.text: Erectile dysfunction is common and treatable medical condition.
ed_common.source: General medical consensus; no prevalence number used (NIDDK figure not verified this session)

glp1_appetite.text: GLP-1 medicines act on appetite centers in the brain and slow stomach emptying, which can reduce hunger and make people feel full sooner.
glp1_appetite.source: FDA labeling for approved GLP-1 products; general pharmacology

tirz_dual.text: Tirzepatide acts on two hormone receptors, GIP and GLP-1.
tirz_dual.source: FDA labeling for approved tirzepatide product

glp1_side_effects.text: Nausea, vomiting, diarrhea and constipation are common GLP-1 side effects.
glp1_side_effects.source: FDA labeling for approved GLP-1 products

compounded_not_approved.text: Compounded semaglutide and tirzepatide are not FDA-approved.

process.text: Online questionnaire, licensed provider reviews it, if appropriate a licensed pharmacy ships it. Cash-pay, 50 states, prescribing never guaranteed.
process.source: Beema /sildenafil and /tadalafil pages; CLAUDE.md business facts 2026-10-12

bpc_not_fda_approved.text: BPC-157 is not an FDA-approved drug product.
bpc_not_fda_approved.source: Beema /bpc-157 FAQ (src/landing-variants/bpc-157/shared.ts). Not independently checked against Drugs@FDA this session.

bpc_what_it_is.text: BPC-157 is a short synthetic peptide, a chain of 15 amino acids, based on part of a protein found in human gastric juice.
bpc_what_it_is.source: Beema /bpc-157 FAQ; consistent with secondary summaries. No primary paper was read.

bpc_human_evidence_limited.text: Most published BPC-157 research is in lab and animal studies; human research is very limited, so whether it works and how safe it is in people is not established.
bpc_human_evidence_limited.source: Secondary summaries of the 2025 HSS Journal systematic review (Vasireddi et al., PMID 40756949: 36 included studies, 35 preclinical, 1 clinical case series). The PubMed page could not be fetched, so these figures were NOT confirmed from the primary source. Beema /bpc-157 FAQ says 'mostly in laboratory and animal studies'.

bpc_fda_safety_info_limited.text: FDA's bulk-drug-substances page says it has identified no, or only limited, safety-related information for BPC-157's proposed routes of administration.
bpc_fda_safety_info_limited.source: fda.gov 'Certain bulk drug substances for use in compounding that may present significant safety risks', content current as of 2026-04-22, fetched 2026-11-16. BPC-157 sits under 'nominated but withdrawn'. NOT used in the spoken script; kept for the reviewer.

bpc_compounding_eligibility.text: Compounded BPC-157 may lawfully be prepared and prescribed in the states Beema serves.
bpc_compounding_eligibility.source: UNRESOLVED. FDA page status is ambiguous (withdrawn from category 2, not on a 503A bulks list as far as verified) and secondary sources conflict on 2026 changes. Also touches LegitScript Standard 2 (no facilitating unapproved or unauthorized medications) and Beema's own disclosure 'considered only when legally available'.

no_charge_if_not_prescribed.text: You won't be charged anything if you aren't prescribed.
no_charge_if_not_prescribed.source: Beema live pages: sexual-health-page.ts, weight-loss-page.ts, glp-1-landing.ts. Absent from the BPC-157 pages (see products.json bpc-157.no_charge).

bpc_gastric_protein_origin.text: BPC-157's sequence is based on part of a protein found in human gastric (stomach) fluid; the protein is a long chain of amino acids and BPC-157 is one 15-amino-acid piece of that chain.
bpc_gastric_protein_origin.source: Beema /bpc-157 FAQ ('based on part of a protein found in human gastric juice'). Generic 'proteins are chains of amino acids' is basic biology. No primary paper was read this session.

gut_hormone_signals.text: After a meal the gut releases hormones that signal the brain (including GLP-1 and GIP); the 'text alerts' framing is a metaphor.
gut_hormone_signals.source: General physiology; consistent with FDA labeling for approved GLP-1/GIP products.

starter_pack_price.text: Compounded tirzepatide starter pack is $199 a month; more pricing plans are on beemahealth.com/tirzepatide.
starter_pack_price.source: Matt corrected the price to $199 a month on 2026-11-16 (an earlier $197 was wrong). Matches src/lib/medication-pricing.ts ($597 per 3 months, $199/month, new-to-GLP-1 patients). Pack length and eligibility wording still to confirm.

semaglutide_glp1_receptor.text: Semaglutide is a GLP-1 receptor agonist: a medicine built to activate the GLP-1 receptor.
semaglutide_glp1_receptor.source: FDA labeling for approved semaglutide products (mechanism of the molecule). Says nothing about any compounded preparation's quality or equivalence to an approved product.

appetite_signaling_not_willpower_alone.text: Appetite and fullness are shaped by hormones and gut-brain signaling, not by willpower alone.
appetite_signaling_not_willpower_alone.source: General physiology; reviews are listed in src/lib/__tests__/fixtures/verified-citations.json (Drucker, Cell Metab 2018, GLP-1 mechanisms; Moiz, Am J Med 2025, GLP-1 RA central and peripheral appetite pathways). Titles seen, papers NOT re-read for this video.

mechanism_metaphor_illustrations.text: Scenes for willpower versus biology (balance), hunger as radio static, a key and one lock, appetite centers lighting up, and a conveyor belt slowing are METAPHORS. They illustrate signaling and stomach emptying in plain language; they are not literal anatomy, not to scale and not a result for any person.
mechanism_metaphor_illustrations.source: Creative device, no source. Radio static as a picture of hunger and 'conveyor belt running slower' imply an effect on the viewer; Matt decides whether they stay.
